pulag.title: Mount Pulag
pulag.location: Borders Benguet, Ifugao, and Nueva Vizcaya provinces, with major jump-offs in Kabayan, Benguet

explore.Ambangeg Trail:: Easiest, perfect for beginners, takes 4-5 hours.
explore.Akiki Trail:: Challenging, steeper route for experienced hikers.
explore.Tawangan Trail:: Known as the "raw" trail, often considered challenging.

pulag.recommended: Summer (dry season) offers the best chance for sea of clouds without rain.
pulag.requirement: A Medical Certificate indicating "fit to hike" is mandatory, along with DENR registration.
description: Mount Pulag is Luzon's highest peak at 2,928 metres (9,606 ft) above sea level, third-highest mountain in the Philippines, and the 26th-highest peak of an island on Earth.

It is second-most prominent mountain in the Philippines. Located on the triple border of the provinces of Benguet, Ifugao, and Nueva Vizcaya, the borders meet at the mountain's peak. Mount Pulag is third highest next to Mount Apo and Mount Dulang-dulang.
Mount Pulag is famous for its "sea of clouds" and its exceptional view of the Milky Way Galaxy at dawn, which has attracted many tourists who wish to see the other-worldly scenery.

hundred.title: Hundred Islands

explore.Bus:: Take a direct bus in Cubao or Pasay directly to Alaminos City.
explore.Tricycle:: From the Alaminos terminal, take a tricycle to Lucap Wharf
explore.Boat:: Register at the Lucap Tourism Office and hire a boat for island hopping.

hundred.recommended: Dry season (November to May) to maximize island hopping and water activities.
hundred.requirement: Need a valid ID, to register at the Pangasinan TARANA portal (if required), and to register at the Lucap Wharf Tourism Office upon arrival to pay environmental and entrance fees
description: The Hundred Islands National Park is the first Philippine national park and a protected area located in Alaminos, Pangasinan. The islands, totaling 124 at low tide and 123 at high tide, are scattered in Lingayen Gulf covering an area of 16.76 square kilometres (6.47 sq mi). Only four of them had been developed for tourism: Quezon Island (the most developed), Governor Island Children's Island, and Pilgrimage Island.

The islands are of karst or limestone landscape. The islands are believed to be about two million years old. Ancient coral formations can be found extending well inland, in areas that were once part of the seabed of a prehistoric sea. A drop in sea level over time exposed these corals at the surface.

coron.title: Coron
coron.location: Coast of neighboring Busuanga Island in Northern Palawan

explore.Airport:: Flight from Manila to Francisco B. Reyes Airport (USU) in Busuanga
explore.Cargo ship: 2Go Travel operates overnight ferries from Manila to Coron

coron.recommended: Dry Season (March–May) and Cool Dry Season (December–February) for comfortable temperature
coron.requirement: Requires proof of full vaccination (or vaccination card/VaxCert) and a confirmed booking at a DOT-accredited accommodation
description: Coron, officially the Municipality of Coron, is a municipality in the province of Palawan, Philippines. According to the 2024 census, it has a population of 69,439 people
It is home to the Coron Island Natural Biotic Area, which is listed in the natural category of the UNESCO World Heritage Tentative List

Currently tourism is the top industry in Coron due to local beaches, dive sites, Lagoons and other natural tourist spots. A dozen sunken Japanese warships at depths between 10 and 40 meters (33 and 131 ft) off Coron Island is a diving destination, listed in Forbes Traveler Magazine’s top 10 best scuba diving sites in the world.[citation needed] A description of the diving highlights in 2021 is provided by Dive the World.

mayonluzon.title: Mount Mayon
mayonluzon.location: Covers parts of Legazpi City, Ligao City, and the municipalities of Camalig, Daraga, Guinobatan, Malilipot, Santo Domingo, and Tabaco in Albay

explore.Bus:: Buses from terminals like PITX or Cubao to Legazpi take 10–13 hours.
explore.Airport: Flights from Manila to Bicol International Airport (DRP)..
explore.Local guides: Take a jeepney bound for Camalig from Legazpi and ask to be dropped off for a scenic view of the volcano, often suggested by local guides.

mayonluzon.recommended: Dry season from March to May.
mayonluzon.requirement: Tourists are not allowed to enter PDZ without a licensed guide.
description: Mayon, also known as Mount Mayon and Mayon Volcano, is an active stratovolcano in the province of Albay in Bicol, Philippines. A popular tourist destination, it is renowned for its "perfect cone" owing to its symmetric conical shape, and is regarded as sacred in Philippine mythology.

The volcano with its surrounding landscape was declared a national park on July 20, 1938, the first in the nation. It was reclassified as a natural park and renamed the Mayon Volcano Natural Park in 2000. It is the centerpiece of the Albay Biosphere Reserve as declared by UNESCO in 2016, and is currently being nominated as a World Heritage Site.

pinatubo.title: Mount Pinatubo
pinatubo.location: Tripoint boundary of Zambales, Tarlac, and Pampanga provinces

explore.Capas Trail:: The standard route starting from Barangay Sta. Juliana
explore.Shortened Trek: During summer, 4x4s can drive further up the riverbed, reducing the walk to a short 30-minute hike each way
explore.Camping: Take a jeepney bound for Camalig from Legazpi and ask to be dropped off for a scenic view of the volcano, often suggested by local guides.

pinatubo.recommended: During the dry season from December to May, with January to March being ideal for cooler weather and clearer views of the blue-green crater lake.
pinatubo.requirement: Booking an accredited tour (PHP 1,000+ deposit usually required), valid identification (2 original IDs/passports), and physical fitness for a ~7km hike.
description: Mount Pinatubo is an active stratovolcano in the Zambales Mountains in Luzon in the Philippines. Located on the tripoint of Zambales, Tarlac and Pampanga provinces, most people were unaware of its eruptive history before the pre-eruption volcanic activity in early 1991. Dense forests, which supported a population of several thousand indigenous Aetas, heavily eroded and obscured Pinatubo.

Long before Mount Pinatubo became famous for its cataclysmic eruption, Philippine president Ramon Magsaysay, a native of Zambales, named his C-47 presidential plane Mt. Pinatubo. The plane crashed into Mount Manunggal in Cebu province in 1957, killing the president and twenty-four others on board.

banaue.title: Banaue Rice Terraces
banaue.location: Located in the mountains of Banaue, in the province of Ifugao

explore.Batad Village & Amphitheater:: The most popular route, offering a stunning amphitheater-like view of the rice terraces
explore.Tappiya Waterfalls Hike: A challenging, steep, and often slippery hike leading to a massive waterfall near the Batad terraces
explore.Camping: A longer, intermediate-level hike connecting Batad to the more rustic village of Cambulo.

banaue.recommended: Lush green during April to May and October to November, and harvest season during June and December
banaue.requirement: Registering with the local government, paying a 50-peso environmental fee, and booking accredited accommodation. Travelers must bring a vaccination card, plan for an 8-10 hour drive from Manila, and prepare for extensive walking, as many areas require hiking, particularly for accessing Batad Rice Terraces.
description: The Banaue Rice Terraces are terraces that were carved into the mountains of Banaue, Ifugao, in the Philippines, by the ancestors of the Igorot people. The terraces were built with minimal equipment, largely by hand. The terraces are located approximately 1,500 meters (4,900 feet) above sea level. These are fed by an ancient irrigation system from the rainforests above the terraces.

Another thriving economy in the Banaue Rice Terraces is tourism. The Tourism industry has developed a number of activities for visitors which may include traditional sightseeing of the terraces and visits to the tribes at the foot of the terraces.

calaguas.title: Calaguas Island
calaguas.location: Municipality of Vinzons, in the Province of Camarines Norte

explore.Paracle:: The most popular route, offering a stunning amphitheater-like view of the rice terraces
explore.Vehicle:: Take a bus to Daet, then a van/jeep to Paracale (1 hr) or Vinzons (1 hr)

calaguas.requirement: Tourists are not allowed to enter PDZ without a licensed guide.
description: Calaguas, also known as Calaguas Islands, is a group of islands located in the Philippine province of Camarines Norte. It includes the major islands of Tinaga Island and Guintinua Island, the minor Maculabo Island, as well as several other minor. The group of islands is around 200 km away from the capital city of Manila and can be accessed through the ports at Paracale and Daet, Camarines Norte.

The recent popularity of Calaguas Island has brought many tourists and travelers, especially during the summer. This has worried some of the natives and locals that increased tourism and the 2018 Boracay closure and redevelopment might lead to the detriment of the island's peace and serenity.

sabtang.title: Sabtang Island
sabtang.location: Municipality in the province of Batanes

explore.Port:: Take a 30–45 minute faluwa (traditional boat) ride from Ivana Port in Batan.

sabtang.recommended: Dry Season (February - May) is ideal for calm sea-crossing and sunny days.
sabtang.requirement: Register at the Batanes Tourism Office in Basco and pay environmental fees, secure a seat on the faluwa (traditional boat) from Ivana Port (usually departing early morning), and hire a local tricycle tour guide upon arrival to visit sites like Chavayan and Morong Beach.
description: Sabtang Island is a breathtaking, well-preserved, and southernmost island municipality in Batanes, Philippines, renowned for its traditional Ivatan stone houses, rocky coastlines, and vibrant green rolling hills. Known for its raw beauty and cultural heritage, it offers a glimpse into traditional life, with popular attractions including the Chamantad-Tinyan Viewpoint, Chavayan and Savidug villages, and the natural rock arch of Morong Beach.

The municipality is the southernmost island municipality in the Batanes Group of Islands. It consists primarily of Sabtang Island and two smaller and uninhabited islands nearby, namely, Ivuhos and Dequey. The municipality is known for its lighthouse and the old stone houses of the Ivatan villages of Chavayan and Savidug. Like Batan Island to the north, Sabtang also has a few Mission-style churches and white sand beaches.

pagsanjan.title: Pagsanjan Falls
pagsanjan.location: Municipality of Cavinti, province of Laguna

explore.Shooting the Rapids:: Traditional dugout canoe ride departing from the town of Pagsanjan
explore.Trekking:: A land-based route through Pueblo El Salvador Nature Park in Cavinti, which involves stairs and rappelling

pagsanjan.recommended: August & September offer the most exciting, fast-paced "shooting the rapids" experience, while Dec-April offers a calmer, safer ride
pagsanjan.requirement: Booking a boat ride from Pagsanjan town (approx. PHP 1,250–1,500+ per person) or taking the land route/trekking via Pueblo El Salvador in Cavinti (approx. PHP 270–300 fee)
description: agsanjan Falls, also known as Magdapio Falls or Cavinti Falls, is one of the Philippines' most iconic, three-tiered waterfalls located in Laguna province. Reached via a thrilling "shooting the rapids" canoe ride from Pagsanjan or a hike from Cavinti, it offers a scenic boat journey through a rocky gorge to a 91-meter-high main falls.

he boat ride has been an attraction since the Spanish colonial era, with the oldest surviving written account dating to 1894. The town of Pagsanjan lies at the confluence of two rivers, the Balanac River and the Bumbungan River (also known as the Pagsanjan River).

taal.title: Taal Lake
taal.location: Surrounding the municipalities of Talisay, Laurel, Agoncillo, San Nicolas, Balete, Mataasnakahoy, Cuenca, Alitagtag, Tanauan, Lipa, Malvar, and Sta. Teresita, Batangas

explore.Expressway:: From Manila via SLEX and STAR Tollway going to Tagaytay Ridge
explore.Tanauan–Talisay Road:: From Batangas City through Tanauan–Talisay Road
explore.Via PITX:: Public bus from PITX to Tagaytay then jeepney or tricycle to Talisay

taal.recommended: November to February for cooler weather and clearer lake views
taal.requirement: Valid ID, Extra clothes and water, boat fare budget if visiting Volcano Island and weather monitoring for volcanic activity alerts
description: Taal Lake is one of the most famous volcanic lakes in the Philippines and surrounds the iconic Taal Volcano. The lake was formed by prehistoric eruptions and is known for its scenic beauty, calm waters, and panoramic viewpoints from Tagaytay.

Visitors can enjoy boating, sightseeing, lakeside dining, and photography while appreciating the unique geography of a volcano within a lake. The surrounding communities also offer cultural experiences and local delicacies such as tawilis and bulalo.

balite.title: Balite Falls

explore.Aguinaldo Hwy:: Drive from Manila through Aguinaldo Highway to Amadeo
explore.PITX:: Bus from PITX to Tagaytay then jeepney to Amadeo
explore.Private route:: Private motorcycle route via Dasmariñas–Indang Road

balite.recommended: Dry season from December to May
balite.requirement: Entrance fee, food and water supplies and swimming materials
description: Balite Falls is a refreshing natural waterfall destination surrounded by greenery and cool flowing water. The area is popular among families and travelers looking for a quick nature getaway near Metro Manila.
The waterfall has natural pools suitable for swimming and relaxing. The peaceful environment and shaded surroundings make it ideal for picnics, bonding activities, and weekend outings.

isarog.title: Mount Isarog
isarog.location: Spans the municipalities/cities of Goa, Ocampo, Pili, Naga City, Calabanga, and Tinambac, Camarines Sur; main jump-off often via Barangay Panicuason, Naga City

explore.Van:: Fly to Naga City then travel by van to the jump-off point
explore.Bus:: Bus from Manila to Naga then jeepney to Goa or Pili
explore.Private tour: Private vehicle through Maharlika Highway to Camarines Sur

isarog.recommended: January to May for safer trekking conditions
isarog.requirement: Must have registration with local tourism office, local guide, hiking gear and enough quipments
description: Mount Isarog is a dormant stratovolcano and protected natural park in Camarines Sur. It is known for its lush forests, rich biodiversity, waterfalls, and cool mountain climate.

The mountain is a favorite destination for hikers and eco-tourists because of its challenging trails and scenic landscapes. Rare flora and fauna can also be found in the area, making it important for conservation and research.

minalungao.title: Minalungao National Park
minalungao.location: Barangay Pias, General Tinio, Nueva Ecija

explore.Drive:: Drive from Manila through SCTEX and Gapan
explore.Bus:: Bus to Cabanatuan then jeepney to General Tinio
explore.Motor rides:: Motorcycle ride through Nueva Ecija countryside routes

minalungao.requirement: Entrance fee, food and water supplies and swimming materials
description: Minalungao National Park is famous for its emerald-green river surrounded by towering limestone cliffs. The natural scenery offers a peaceful escape from urban life and is ideal for outdoor activities.
Visitors can enjoy bamboo rafting, cliff jumping, swimming, and hiking. The park’s crystal-clear river and dramatic rock formations make it one of Nueva Ecija’s most visited natural attractions.

apao.title: Apao Rolling Hills
apao.location: Barangay Apao within the remote, northernmost municipality of Tineg, Abra

explore.Bus:: Bus from Manila to Sagada via Banaue.
explore.Van:: Van transfer from Baguio City to Sagada.

apao.requirement: Hiking equiment and local guide if exploring nearby trails
description: Apao Rolling Hills features vast grassy landscapes and scenic mountain views that resemble the famous hills of Batanes. The peaceful environment and cool climate make it attractive for camping and sightseeing.

The hills provide stunning sunrise and sunset views, especially during foggy mornings. Travelers often visit the area to relax, take photographs, and experience the calm atmosphere of the Cordillera region.

maniwaya.title: Maniwaya Island

explore.Bus:: Bus from Manila to Lucena then ferry to Marinduque.
explore.Airport:: Flight to Marinduque then boat transfer.
explore.Port:: Private vehicle to General Luna Port followed by boat ride.

maniwaya.requirement: Reservation for resorts or cottages, Local ID and Beach essentials
description: Maniwaya Island is known for its white sand beaches, turquoise waters, and laid-back island atmosphere. It is one of Marinduque’s top island destinations for beach lovers and weekend travelers.
Visitors can enjoy island hopping, snorkeling, swimming, and relaxing by the shore. The island also features sandbars and beautiful sunsets that attract photographers and nature enthusiasts.

tubbataha.title: Tubbataha Reefs
tubbataha.location: Sulu Sea, under jurisdiction of Cagayancillo, Palawan

explore.Tour guide:: Fly to Puerto Princesa then join a liveaboard diving tour
explore.Organization:: Organized eco-tour packages from Puerto Princesa City

tubbataha.requirement: Diving certification for scuba activities, advance booking for liveaboard tours, environmental fee and safety diving equipment
description: Tubbataha Reefs is a UNESCO World Heritage Site recognized for its exceptional marine biodiversity and pristine coral reef ecosystems. It is considered one of the best diving destinations in the world.

The protected marine park is home to sharks, sea turtles, manta rays, and hundreds of fish species. Due to its remote location, access is limited and carefully managed to preserve its ecological importance.

banahaw.title: Mount Banahaw
banahaw.location: Border of Majayjay, Laguna and Lucban/Sariaya, Quezon

explore.SLEX:: Drive from Manila via SLEX to Lucban
explore.Bus:: Bus from Manila to Lucena then jeepney to jump-off points
explore.Private tour:: Private motorcycle route through Laguna towns.

banahaw.requirement: Hiking permit, local guide, trekking gear and respect for sacred sites and local customs
description: Mount Banahaw is a dormant volcano considered a sacred mountain by many Filipinos. It attracts pilgrims, spiritual seekers, and hikers because of its religious significance and natural beauty.
The mountain features dense forests, rivers, caves, and waterfalls. Its cool climate and spiritual atmosphere create a unique experience that combines adventure and cultural heritage.

ticao.title: Ticao Island
ticao.location: Municipalities of San Jacinto, Monreal, and Batuan, Masbate

explore.Aiport and Ferry:: Flight to Masbate City then ferry to Ticao Island
explore.Bus and Ferry:: Bus from Manila to Sorsogon then boat transfer
explore.Private tour:: Private vehicle via Bicol region ports

ticao.requirement: Boat transportation budget, resort reservation, and snorkeling or diving gear
description: Ticao Island is a tropical island destination famous for diving spots, whale shark interactions, and marine biodiversity. Its waters are rich with coral reefs and unique underwater ecosystems.
The island also offers scenic beaches, fishing communities, and peaceful coastal landscapes. Travelers visit Ticao Island for eco-tourism adventures and relaxing island experiences.

hinagdanan.title: Hinagdanan Cave

explore.From Alona Beach / Panglao:: 15-30 min ride trip including waiting time. Drivers usually know it and some act as informal guides.
explore.Tagbilaran City:: Take a bus from Tagbilaran Integrated Bus Terminal to Dauis/Calape, then tricycle to the cave.

hinagdanan.recommended: Year-round; best during the morning to see sunlight filtering through the ceiling holes
hinagdanan.requirement: Pay an entrance fee and a separate fee if you intend to swim; local guides are available at the entrance
description: Hinagdanan Cave is a cave in the municipality of Dauis on Panglao Island, in Bohol Province, in the Philippines. It is a naturally lighted cavern with a deep lagoon and many large stalactites and stalagmites. The cave is lit by sunlight which filters through holes in the ceiling.

Hinagdanan Cave is a naturally lighted limestone cavern featuring a deep blue lagoon and numerous stalactites and stalagmites. It was accidentally discovered by a farmer clearing his land. The cave’s name, "Hinagdanan" means "laddered" in Cebuano, referring to the access used to enter the cave.

osmena.title: Osmeña Peak

explore.Hiking:: Trek for about 20-30 minutes from the trailhead to the summit
explore.Camping:: Overnight camping is allowed at designated spots near the peak for sunrise views

osmena.recommended: Dry season (December to May) for clear views of the coastline
osmena.requirement: Pay an entrance fee, register at the tourism desk, and pay a guide fee (optional but sometimes required.
description: Osmeña Peak, located in Dalaguete, Cebu, is the highest point on Cebu Island at approximately 1,013 meters (3,323 feet) above sea level. Famous for its 360-degree views and jagged, green limestone hills resembling the Chocolate Hills.
It is a premier eco-tourism destination in Dalaguete, Cebu, popular for its accessible, short hike, and breathtaking 360-degree panoramic views.

chocolatehills.title: Chocolate Hills
chocolatehills.location: Bohol Island primarily spread across the towns of Carmen, Batuan, and Sagbayan

explore.Airport:: Fly directly from NAIA to Bohol-Panglao International Airport (TAG)
explore.Transportation:: fly directly from NAIA to Bohol-Panglao International Airport (TAG). From there, hire a private taxi, rent a scooter, or take a guided Bohol Countryside Tour

chocolatehills.recommended: Dry season (late November to May) when the grass turns brown, giving them their name.
chocolatehills.requirement: Must pay an entrance fee—adjusted to ₱150 per person effective
description: The Chocolate Hills are a geological formation in the Philippine province of Bohol. A minimum of 1,260 hills, and possibly over 1,776, spread over an area of more than 50 square kilometers (20 sq mi). They are covered in green grass that turns a chocolate-brown during the dry season, hence the name.

The Chocolate Hills are featured on the provincial flag and seal to symbolize the abundance of natural attractions in the province. The site is on the Philippine Tourism Authority's list of tourist destinations in the Philippines, and it has been declared the country's third national geological monument, as well as being proposed for inclusion in UNESCO's World Heritage List.

kawasan.title: Kawasan Falls

explore.From Moalboal:: Take a southbound Ceres bus from the main road, rent a scooter for flexibility, or hire a tricycle/habal-habal directly to the Matutinao entrance
explore.From Cebu City:: Head to the South Bus Terminal and board a bus bound for Bato
explore.Private tour: Many operators provide round-trip van transfers from your hotel directly to the trailhead

kawasan.recommended: Weekdays during the dry season to avoid large crowds and ensure safe water levels for canyoneering
kawasan.requirement: Secure a certified guide for canyoneering; pay environmental and entrance fees
description: Kawasan Falls is a multi-layered waterfall system located in Barangay Matutinao in the town of Badian, Cebu. It is without doubt the most visited tourist attraction here in Badian.

Famous for its beautiful turquoise water, Kawasan Falls sits at the foot of Mantalongon Mountain Range, approximately one kilometer from the national road of Badian and at least four hours of trekking from Osmeña Peak of Dalaguete. Its cold and clear water cascades through layers of waterfalls emanating from Kandayvic Spring before going to Matutinao River and the Tañon Strait.

The waterfall system consists of two main cascades both with deep natural pools ideal for swimming. The first cascade stands at approximately 40 meters while the less crowded second level has a height of approximately 20 meters and can be reached within ten minutes of trekking.

boracayisland.title: Boracay
boracayisland.location: Northwest coast of Panay Island, province of Aklan

explore.Caticlan Airport: fly into Caticlan Airport (Boracay Airport / MPH)
explore.Caticlan Port:: Caticlan Airport (Boracay Airport / MPH), take a 5-minute tricycle to Caticlan Jetty Port and ride a 15-minute ferry to the island.

boracayisland.recommended: November to June (Amihan season) for the calmest waters on White Beach
boracayisland.requirement: Valid ID, hotel booking confirmation (from accredited establishments), and QR code registration via the Aklan provincial portal
description: Boracay is a world-renowned tropical resort island in the Philippines, located off the northwest coast of Panay. Famous for its powdery white sand, crystal-clear turquoise waters, and stunning sunsets, it is the country's premier beach destination

Apart from its white sand beaches, Boracay is also famous for being one of the world's top destinations for relaxation. As of 2013, it was emerging among the top destinations for tranquility and nightlife

pitogo.title: Pitogo Cliff
pitogo.location: Barangay Tag-ibo (or Barangay Pitogo), San Juan, Siquijor

explore.Vehicle:: Rent a motorbike, hire a local tricycle, or book a guided coastal island tour

pitogo.requirement: Pay a small entrance fee to the local landowners or community.
description: The Pitogo Cliff is a magnificent cliff located on Siquijor, an island in the Philippines. This cliff offers a breathtaking view of the ocean and surrounding landscape. It is renowned for its natural beauty and peaceful atmosphere. Pitogo Cliff is characterised by its steep cliffs plunging into the crystal-clear waters of the sea.
The cliffs are covered in lush vegetation, creating a striking contrast with the deep blue of the ocean. Visitors can stroll along the cliffs and enjoy breathtaking views.

apois.title: Apo Island
apois.location: 7 km off the southeastern tip of Negros Island

explore.Transportation:: Fly to Dumaguete City, take a 30-minute jeepney, bus, or tricycle ride to Malatapay Market in Zamboanguita
explore.Port:: take a 30-45 minute authorized pump boat to the island

apois.recommended: Year-round, but April to September offers the calmest seas for the boat crossing
apois.requirement: Register at the Malatapay Wharf, pay the marine sanctuary fee, and hire a mandatory snorkeling guide
description: Apo Island, located 7 km off the southeastern tip of Negros Island and 30 km south of Dumaguete, is a world-renowned 74-hectare volcanic island famous for its thriving community-managed marine sanctuary. It is home to over 650 fish species, 400 coral species, and a high concentration of green and hawksbill sea turtles.

The marine habitat around the island is a marine reserve, protected by the National Integrated Protected Area Act (NIPA) and under the jurisdiction of the Protected Area Management Board (PAMB). It has become a popular dive site and snorkeling destination with tourists. There are two resorts on Apo Island, each with a dive center: Apo Island Beach Resort and Liberty's Lodge. There is also a ranger station and a lighthouse.

manjuyod.title: Manjuyod Sandbar
manjuyod.location: North Bais Bay of the Tañon Strait, between the municipality of Manjuyod and Bais City, eastern coast of Negros Oriental

explore.Plane and Bus: Fly to Dumaguete City and take a 1-hour Ceres bus to Bais City
explore.Motor boat:: Rent a motorized outrigger boat for a 15 to 20-minute ride to the sandbar

manjuyod.recommended: Dry season; time your visit during low tide to see the white sand emerge
manjuyod.requirement: Book a boat at the Capiñahan or Canibol Wharf; pay the docking and environmental fees
description: The Manjuyod Sandbar is a stunning 7-kilometer stretch of powdery white sand in Negros Oriental, Philippines. Widely known as the "Maldives of the Philippines," it features crystal-clear teal waters and famous stilt cottages. The sandbar is fully submerged during high tide and emerges during low tide.

One of the unique features of Manjuyod Sandbar is the cluster of small huts that are built on stilts in the water. These huts, known as “cottages,” are available for rent and offer visitors a chance to stay overnight on the sandbar. They are equipped with basic amenities like electricity, running water, and a small kitchen, and they provide a unique and unforgettable experience for visitors who want to immerse themselves in the natural beauty of the sandbar

kalanggaman.title: Kalanggaman Island

explore.Pampolon route: Take a 1.5-hour UV Express or van to Palompon. Walk or take a short tricycle ride to the Palompon Tourism Office
explore.Registration:: Register at the Palompon Tourism Office before hiring a motorized outrigger boat for a 1-hour ride to the island

kalanggaman.recommended: March to May for the calmest weather and most visible sandbar
kalanggaman.requirement: Pre-registration at the Palompon Eco-Tourism Office is required as there is a daily limit on visitors
description: Kalanggaman Island is a sandbar located in the sea between Leyte and Cebu, in the Visayas Archipelago of the Philippines. It is located 10 kilometres west from the municipality of Palompon, Leyte. It got its name from the local word "langgam" which means bird or fowl.

Kalanggaman Island is famous for its long, white sandbar that stretches out from both ends of the island. It is an uninhabited paradise with no large resorts, offering a raw and peaceful beach experience surrounded by turquoise waters.

carbin.title: Carbin Reef
carbin.location: Sagay Marine Reserve off the northern coast of Sagay City, Negros Occidental

explore.Airport:: Fly to Iloilo City then travel to Carles Port
explore.Bus and Ferry:: Bus from Iloilo City to Carles followed by boat ride
explore.Hopping:: Join island-hopping tours in the Gigantes Islands area

carbin.requirement: Boat fare and environmental fee and snorkeling gear
description: Carbin Reef is famous for its long white sandbar and crystal-clear waters. It is one of the highlights of island hopping tours around the Gigantes Islands in Iloilo.
Visitors can swim, snorkel, and relax on the sandbar while enjoying panoramic ocean views. The reef’s beauty becomes more visible during low tide when the white sand stretches across the sea.

danjugan.title: Danjugan Island

explore.Aiport and Ferry:: Fly to Bacolod City then travel to Cauayan Port
explore.Bus and Ferry:: Bus from Bacolod to Cauayan followed by boat transfer
explore.Tour guide:: Organized eco-tourism package from Negros Occidental

danjugan.requirement: Reservation with eco-tour organizers, environmental fee and eco-friendly travel essentials
description: Danjugan Sanctuary is a protected island reserve known for marine conservation and sustainable tourism. The island contains coral reefs, lagoons, caves, and forest habitats.
Eco-tourism activities include snorkeling, kayaking, birdwatching, and guided nature tours. Visitors are encouraged to practice responsible tourism to help preserve the island’s biodiversity.

luho.title: Mount Luho
luho.location: Boracay Island, Barangay Yapak, Malay, Aklan

explore.Aiport and Ferry:: Fly to Caticlan Airport then ferry to Boracay or flight to Kalibo then land transfer to Caticlan Port
explore.Tricycle:: E-tricycle ride from Boracay stations to Mount Luho.

luho.requirement: Environmental and terminal fees,and other photograph equipment
description: Mount Luho is the highest point on Boracay Island and offers panoramic views of the island’s beaches and surrounding seas. It is one of the best spots for sightseeing and photography.
The viewpoint allows visitors to appreciate Boracay’s natural beauty from above. Many tourists visit during sunrise or sunset to enjoy the dramatic scenery and cool breeze.

malumpati.title: Malumpati Cold Spring

explore.Airport and Van:: Fly to Caticlan then travel by van to Pandan
explore.Bus:: Bus from Iloilo City to Antique Province
explore.Private route:: Private vehicle through Panay coastal roads

malumpati.requirement: Entrance fee, food and water supplies and swimming materials and picnic supplies
description: Malumpati Cold Spring is a popular freshwater attraction known for its naturally cold and clear waters. The spring is surrounded by trees and natural rock formations.
Visitors can swim, raft, and enjoy local food near the spring area. The refreshing water and relaxing environment make it ideal for family outings and nature trips.

bucari.title: Bucari Pine Forest
bucari.location: Barangays Bucari, Camandag, and Tabionan, Leon, Iloilo

explore.Road:: Drive from Iloilo City to Leon municipality
explore.Public transportation:: Public jeepney route from Iloilo to Leon or otorcycle ride through mountain roads

bucari.requirement: Camping gear if staying overnight and other hiking equipments
description: Bucari Pine Forest is often called the “Little Baguio of Iloilo” because of its cool weather and pine-covered mountains. The area offers scenic landscapes and fresh mountain air.
Travelers visit Bucari for camping, trekking, and relaxation. Its peaceful environment and natural beauty make it one of Iloilo’s favorite eco-tourism destinations.

mambucal.title: Mambucal Mountain Resort

explore.Vehicle:: Drive from Bacolod City to Murcia or jeepney route from Bacolod public terminal
explore.Tour guide:: Tour package from Negros Occidental resorts

mambucal.requirement: Entrance fee, food and water supplies and swimming materials
description: Mambukal Hot Springs is a mountain resort known for its natural hot sulfur springs, waterfalls, and forest environment. The resort offers both relaxation and adventure activities.
Visitors can enjoy hot spring baths, ziplining, trekking, boating, and wildlife encounters. The cool mountain climate and natural attractions make it a popular destination in Negros Occidental.

cuatro.title: Cuatro Islas
cuatro.location: Municipalities of Inopacan and Hindang, Leyte

explore.Aiport and Ferry:: Fly to Tacloban City then travel to Inopacan Port.
explore.Boat:: Boat tour from Leyte coastal towns or bus from Ormoc to Hindang.

cuatro.requirement: Boat fare and environmental fee and snorkeling gear
description: Cuatro Islas is a group of four beautiful islands known for white sand beaches and clear blue waters. The islands are ideal for swimming, snorkeling, and island hopping.
The destination offers peaceful coastal scenery and rich marine life. Many visitors enjoy camping and beach picnics while exploring the different islands.

sohor.title: Sohoton Cave

explore.Airport:: Fly to Tacloban then cross San Juanico Bridge to Samar
explore.Port:: Boat and eco-tour packages within Samar Province

sohor.requirement: A proffesional tour guide, enviromental fee and proper equipment
description: Sohoton Cave is famous for its impressive limestone formations, underground chambers, and natural bridge. The cave system showcases Samar’s rich geological beauty.
Visitors can explore cave passages, rivers, and rock formations while learning about the area’s natural history. Adventure seekers often include Sohoton Cave in eco-tourism trips around Samar.

sogod.title: Sogod Bay
sogod.location: Municipalities of Sogod, Libagon, Liloan, San Francisco, Pintuyan, San Ricardo, and Padre Burgos, Southern Leyte

explore.Aiport and Bus:: Fly to Tacloban then travel south by bus

sogod.requirement: Boat arrangements for tours, travel reservations and divinga nd snorkeling equipments
description: Sogod Bay is a scenic bay known for whale shark sightings, diving spots, and marine biodiversity. The calm waters and coastal scenery attract both local and international tourists.
Marine tourism activities include snorkeling, scuba diving, and whale shark interaction tours. The bay is also surrounded by peaceful fishing communities and natural landscapes.

mtapo.title: Mount Apo
mtapo.location: Boundaries of Davao City and the provinces of Davao del Sur

explore.Santa Cruz Trail:: It is the shortest route but highly technical
explore.Kidapawan Trail:: Starts in Kidapawan, North Cotabato. Often called the Ko-ong trail, it is the widest route
explore.Kapatagan Trail:: Jump-off is in Digos City/Kapatagan. This route is slightly longer than the others but adjacent to Sibulan
explore.Bansalan Trail:: Starts in Sitio Sumpan/Balutakay, Bansalan, Davao del Sur

mtapo.recommended: Summer months (March to May); trekking is often suspended during the rainy season for safety
mtapo.requirement: Climbing permit (limited slots), a certified guide, and requires a medical certificate
description: Mount Apo is the highest mountain peak in the Philippines, with an elevation of 2,954 meters (9,692 ft) above sea level. A large solfataric, dormant stratovolcano, it is part of the Apo-Talomo Mountain Range of Mindanao island. Apo is situated on the tripartite border of Davao City, Davao del Sur, and Cotabato; its peak is visible from Davao City 45 kilometers (28 mi) to the northeast, Digos 25 kilometers (16 mi) to the southeast, and Bansalan 20 kilometers (12 mi) to the west. Apo is a protected area and is the centerpiece of Mount Apo Natural Park.

Mount Apo is a flat-topped, 2,954 m (9,692 ft) (above sea level) high stratovolcano with three peaks. It is the highest peak of the Philippines. The southwest peak has the highest elevation and is topped by a 200 m (656 ft) wide crater that contains a small lake.

white.title: White Island
white.location: Northern coast of Mambajao in Camiguin

explore.Direct Flight:: Flying directly to Camiguin Airport (CGM) in Mambajao
explore.Ferry Terminal:: Navigate to the White Island Ferry Terminal in Brgy. Yumbing

white.recommended: December to May is the recommended season for sunny weather, with low tide typically providing the best sandbar experience and  5:00 AM and 8:00 AM to avoid intense heat
white.requirement: Register at the jump-off point in Brgy. Agoho and pay the environmental and boat fees.
description: White Island is an uninhabited white sandbar located about 1.4 kilometres (0.87 mi) off the northern shore of Mambajao in the volcanic island of Camiguin in the Philippines. The island is generally horseshoe shaped, although the tides constantly resize and reshape its exact form. There are no trees or shelter of any kind, and it is composed solely of white sands.

White Island attracts thousands of tourists every year. The island can be accessed from Barangay Agoho or Brgy. Yumbing in Mambajao about 4 to 6 kilometres (2.5 to 3.7 mi) west of the poblacion or town center. Small boats can be hired from any of the beachfront resorts that face the island.

pink.title: Pink Sand Beach
pink.location: Great Santa Cruz Island, Basilan Strait, 4 km south of downtown Zamboanga City

explore.Airport:: Hail a tricycle or taxi to Paseo del Mar (near Fort del Pilar)
explore.Boat Ride:: Boats operate daily from 7:00 AM to 2:00 PM. Trips back to the mainland usually wrap up by 3:00 PM

pink.recommended: Year-round, but strictly by daytime reservation only
pink.requirement: Book through the Zamboanga City Tourism Office; no walk-ins are allowed due to strict visitor limits
description: Pink Sand Beach or Great Santa Cruz Island is a small inhabited island in Zamboanga City in the southern region of the Philippines that is famous for its pink coralline sand. The island, located 4 kilometres (2.49 mi) south of downtown at the Santa Cruz Bank in the Basilan Strait, boasts one of the pink sand beaches in the Philippines. The color of the sand comes from the pulverized red organ pipe coral from eons of surf erosion mixed with the white sand.

The island started to become popular since the 1970s and early 1980s when it was frequented by German, Japanese and Italian tourists. Recently, there's an upsurge of tourists that has been recorded due to its rising popularity as one of a handful of Pink Sand Beaches in the World and is the only one in Asia.

sebu.title: Lake Sebu

explore.Terminal:: From GenSan Airport, take a white multicab o the Bulaong Terminal
explore.Direct Van:: Board a direct passenger van straight to Lake Sebu

sebu.recommended: August to October to see the lotus flowers in full bloom
sebu.requirement: Pay entrance fees at individual waterfall sites; follow local T'boli cultural protocols
description: Lake Sebu, is a natural lake located in the municipality of Lake Sebu, South Cotabato within the Alah Valley region. The Philippine government has recognized it as one of the country's most important watersheds. Lake Sebu is one of the many bodies of water supplying important irrigation to the provinces of Sultan Kudarat and South Cotabato.
The villages around the lake have been turned into an independent municipality called Lake Sebu after being a former village of Surallah.

hinatuan.title: Hinatuan Enchanted River
hinatuan.location: Barangay Talisay, Hinatuan, Surigao del Sur

explore.Bus:: Take a Bachelor Express bus from the Butuan Bus Terminal bound for Bislig
explore.Local Transit:: From Hinatuan town, register and pay fees at the designated harbour or tourism office before taking a tricycle or habal-habal (motorcycle) to the Enchanted River

hinatuan.recommended: Weekdays to avoid heavy local crowds
hinatuan.requirement: Pay environmental fees; swimming is no longer allowed in the main "blue hole" to preserve the spring
description: The Hinatuan Enchanted River, also called the Hinatuan Sacred River, is a deep spring river on the island of Mindanao in the Philippines. It flows into the Philippine Sea and the Pacific Ocean at Barangay Talisay, Hinatuan, Surigao del Sur. It is found between the boundaries of Barangays of Talisay and Cambatong. It earned the moniker "enchanted river" from the diplomat Modesto Farolan who described the river in his poem entitled "Rio Encantado".

The Enchanted River is a deep spring river known for its crystalline blue waters that seem to glow. Local legend says fairies and spirits protect the river, which is why the water remains so clear despite the depth, which remains largely unexplored in its underwater cave systems.

siargaois.title: Siargao
siargaois.location: Northeastern corner of Surigao del Norte

explore.Airport:: booking a direct flight to Sayak Airport (IAO)
explore.Ferry:: If you are on a tight budget or bringing a vehicle, you can take the sea route in Cebu to Surigao City and Surigao City to Dapa

siargaois.recommended: August to November for peak surfing; March to May for calmer waters and island hopping
siargaois.requirement: Valid ID; some local establishments may require proof of vaccination or pre-registration via the e-Gov portal
description: Siargao is the "Surfing Capital of the Philippines." Beyond its iconic waves, the island features vast coconut plantations, the emerald waters of Sugba Lagoon, and a laid-back island vibe that attracts travelers from all over the world.
Siargao is composed of 48 islands and islets-politically divided into nine municipalities: Burgos, Dapa, Del Carmen, Gen. luna, Pilar, San Benito, San Isidro, Santa Monica, and Socorro.

holon.title: Lake Holon
holon.location: Atop the active stratovolcano Mount Melibengoy in T'boli, South Cotabato

explore.T'boli Tourism Office:: Commuting to the local municipal tourism office, as walk-ins without proper registration and local guides are strictly prohibited
explore.Habal-Habal:: Charter a local motorcycle taxi—often locally referred to as a "skylab" to take you up the mountain

holon.recommended: Dry season; the park often closes annually (usually January to March) for rehabilitation
holon.requirement: Register at the T'boli Tourism Office and secure a local guide
description: Lake Holon is a crater lake in South Cotobato in the Mindanao region that is also known as the Crown Jewel of the South. Lake Holon is known for its scenic and relaxing view, which makes it one of the top emerging tourist spot in Mindanao and ecotourism.

Formed by the eruption of Mount Melibengoys, Lake Holon is a crater lake sitting at 1,756 meters above sea level. It is considered sacred by the T'boli tribe and is known for its pristine, cold waters and the "Crown of the Peaks" that surrounds it.

tinuy.title: Tinuy-an Falls
tinuy.location: Barangay Burboanan, Bislig City, Surigao del Sur

explore.Gateways:: Reach the Gateways because Bislig City does not handle commercial flights, you will need to fly or travel into one of the nearest major transport hubs
explore.Habal-Habal:: Most common and adventurous method. You can hire a driver at the public market or terminal
explore.Bao-Bao:: Rent a local tricycle/bao-bao or a private rental van

tinuy.recommended: Rainy season (November to February) for the most powerful water flow
tinuy.requirement: Pay the entrance and parking fees at the tourism gate
description: Tinuy-an Falls is a multi-tiered waterfall in Bislig, Surigao del Sur in the southern island of Mindanao, Philippines. Bislig is a city known as the Booming City by the Bay. The waterfall itself has been featured in various international travel magazines and TV shows.

Known as the "Little Niagara Falls of the Philippines," Tinuy-an Falls is a multi-tiered curtain waterfall that spans 95 meters in width. It is one of the widest waterfalls in the country, surrounded by a lush forest protected as a sanctuary.

hamiguitan.title: Mount Hamiguitan
hamiguitan.location: San Isidro, Governor Generoso, and Mati, Davao Oriental

explore.GovGen–San Isidro trail:: Very challenging 3-day expedition spanning roughly 30–35 km

hamiguitan.requirement: Strict permit requirements from the PAMB (Protected Area Management Board); only limited hikers are allowed
description: Mount Hamiguitan is a mountain located in the province of Davao Oriental, Philippines. It has a height of 1,620 metres. The mountain and its vicinity has one of the most diverse wildlife populations in the country. Among the wildlife found in the area are Philippine eagles and several species of Nepenthes.

Mount Hamiguitan is a UNESCO World Heritage site famous for its unique "pygmy" or bonsai forest. The mountain is a critical habitat for the Philippine Eagle and the Philippine Cockatoo, representing a diverse range of flora and fauna found nowhere else on Earth

bucas.title: Bucas Grande
bucas.location: Municipality of Socorro, Surigao del Norte

explore.Ferry Terminal:: Ferry from Surigao City to Socorro town.

bucas.requirement: Boat arrangements for tours, travel reservations and divinga nd snorkeling equipments
description: Bucas Grande is famous for Sohoton Cove, lagoons, caves, and jellyfish sanctuaries. The island is one of the top eco-tourism attractions in Surigao del Norte.
Its crystal-clear waters and limestone formations create breathtaking scenery for kayaking and island exploration. Visitors enjoy the peaceful atmosphere and unique natural attractions.

musuan.title: Musuan Peak

explore.Bus:: Bus route from Davao City to Maramag

musuan.requirement: Hiking gear and professional local tourist guide needed for journey
description: Musuan Peak is a dormant volcano with a short but rewarding hiking trail. It offers panoramic views of Bukidnon’s plains and mountain ranges.
The peak is also home to rich grasslands and educational research areas because of its proximity to Central Mindanao University. Sunrise hikes are especially popular among visitors.

once.title: Once Islas

explore.Transportation:: Public transport from downtown Davao to jump-off port
explore.Private tour:: Private vehicle and boat tour package

once.requirement: Boat fare and environmental fee and snorkeling gear
description: Once Islas is a protected group of islands in Davao Gulf known for coral reefs, mangroves, and white sand beaches. It is a growing eco-tourism destination in Mindanao.
Visitors can enjoy snorkeling, swimming, kayaking, and island hopping. The area promotes marine conservation while offering relaxing coastal scenery.

matutum.title: Mount Matutum
matutum.location: Municipalities of Polomolok and Tupi, South Cotabato

explore.Airport:: Fly to General Santos City then travel to Polomolok
explore.Transportation:: Bus from Davao City to South Cotabato or private vehicle through Mindanao highways

matutum.requirement: Hiking permit, local guide, trekking gear and trekking and camping gear is necessary required
description: Mount Matutum is an active stratovolcano recognized for its cone-shaped summit and rich biodiversity. The mountain is home to forests, wildlife, and scenic landscapes.
Hikers are rewarded with panoramic views of South Cotabato and nearby provinces. The trek also provides opportunities to encounter rare birds and unique plant species.

monfort.title: Monfort Bat Sanctuary
monfort.location: Barangay Tambo, Babak District, Island Garden City of Samal, Davao Del Norte

explore.Ferry Terminal:: Ferry to Samal Island or Public boat from Sasa Wharf to Samal

monfort.requirement: Entrance fee, face mask for sensitive visitors and local tour guide and having camera for your photography
description: Monfort Bat Sanctuary is home to millions of Geoffroy’s rousette fruit bats and is recognized as one of the world’s largest bat colonies. The sanctuary promotes wildlife protection and environmental awareness.
Visitors can observe bats in their natural habitat and learn about their ecological importance. The sanctuary also contributes to conservation and eco-tourism in Samal Island.

mapawa.title: Mapawa Nature Park
mapawa.location: Barangay Cugman, Cagayan de Oro City, Misamis Orriental

explore.Airport and Van:: Fly to Cagayan de Oro then travel by van or taxi
explore.Transportation:: Public transport from downtown CDO to Cugman or private vehicle through mountain roads

mapawa.requirement: Entrance fee, hiking gear and extra clothes for water activity
description: Mapawa Nature Park is an outdoor adventure destination featuring waterfalls, horseback riding, hiking trails, and river activities. The park combines recreation with natural scenery.
Adventure seekers enjoy trekking, camping, ziplining, and ATV rides in the area. The park’s waterfalls and green landscapes make it a refreshing getaway near the city.

panimahawa.title: Panimahawa Ridge

explore.Aiport and Bus:: Fly to Cagayan de Oro then bus to Impasug-ong
explore.Transportation:: Private vehicle via Bukidnon highways or motorcycle route through mountain roads

panimahawa.requirement: Hiking gear and professional local tourist guide needed for journey
description: Panimahawa Ridge is known for its rolling hills, sea of clouds, and cool mountain climate. The ridge offers scenic camping experiences and panoramic views of Bukidnon.
Travelers often visit for sunrise hikes and overnight camping. The peaceful atmosphere and dramatic landscapes make it one of the region’s hidden gems.

gumasa.title: Gumasa Beach

explore.Airport and Van:: Fly to General Santos City then van to Glan
explore.Bus:: Bus route from Davao to Sarangani

gumasa.requirement: Reservation for resorts or cottages, Local ID and Beach essentials
description: Description: Gumasa Beach is famous for its white sand shoreline and clear waters, often compared to Boracay because of its beauty. The beach is a major attraction in Sarangani Province.
Visitors enjoy swimming, beach camping, volleyball, and local festivals such as Sarangani Bay Festival. The peaceful coastal environment makes it ideal for relaxation and recreation.

maria.title: Maria Cristina Falls
maria.location: Barangay Maria Cristina, Iligan City, Lanao del Norte

explore.Direct Flight:: Fly to Cagayan de Oro then travel to Iligan City
explore.Bus:: Bus from Davao or Bukidnon to Iligan
explore.Private tour:: Private vehicle through Northern Mindanao highways

maria.requirement: Entrance fee, food and water supplies and swimming materials
description: Maria Cristina Falls is one of the most famous waterfalls in the Philippines and is known as the “Twin Falls” because a rock divides the water flow. The falls also power a major hydroelectric plant in Mindanao.

The powerful cascading waters and surrounding forest scenery attract tourists and photographers. Viewing decks allow visitors to safely admire the falls while learning about its role in energy production.
